# Instalasi & Go CLI

## Cara Install Go

### Windows
1. Kunjungi [go.dev/dl](https://go.dev/dl)
2. Unduh installer `.msi` versi terbaru
3. Jalankan installer dan ikuti petunjuk
4. Go akan otomatis menambahkan dirinya ke PATH

### macOS
```bash
# Menggunakan Homebrew
brew install go
```
Atau unduh `.pkg` installer dari go.dev/dl.

### Linux
```bash
# Unduh dan ekstrak
wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.22.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz
sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.22.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz

# Tambahkan ke PATH di ~/.bashrc atau ~/.profile
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
```

## Verifikasi Instalasi

```bash
go version
```

**Output:**
```
go version go1.22.0 linux/amd64
```

## Melihat Versi Go dari dalam Program

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "runtime"
)

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Go version:", runtime.Version())
    fmt.Println("OS:", runtime.GOOS)
    fmt.Println("Architecture:", runtime.GOARCH)
}
```

## Perintah Go CLI

### `go run` — Jalankan tanpa build
```bash
go run main.go
```
Mengkompilasi dan langsung menjalankan file Go. Cocok untuk development.

### `go build` — Kompilasi ke binary
```bash
go build -o myapp main.go
```
Menghasilkan file executable yang bisa didistribusikan.

### `go fmt` — Format kode otomatis
```bash
go fmt ./...
```
Memformat semua file Go sesuai standar Go (indentasi, spasi, dll).

### `go vet` — Cek bug potensial
```bash
go vet ./...
```
Menganalisis kode dan melaporkan konstruksi yang mencurigakan.

### `go test` — Jalankan unit test
```bash
go test ./...
go test -v ./...    # verbose output
go test -cover ./.. # tampilkan coverage
```

### `go get` — Tambahkan dependency
```bash
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin
```

### Ringkasan Perintah CLI

| Perintah | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `go run` | Kompilasi dan jalankan langsung |
| `go build` | Kompilasi ke binary executable |
| `go fmt` | Format kode sesuai standar Go |
| `go vet` | Analisis kode untuk bug potensial |
| `go test` | Jalankan test suite |
| `go get` | Download dan install dependency |
| `go mod tidy` | Bersihkan dependency yang tidak terpakai |

# Installation & Go CLI

## How to Install Go

### Windows
1. Visit [go.dev/dl](https://go.dev/dl)
2. Download the latest `.msi` installer
3. Run the installer and follow the prompts
4. Go will automatically add itself to PATH

### macOS
```bash
# Using Homebrew
brew install go
```
Or download the `.pkg` installer from go.dev/dl.

### Linux
```bash
# Download and extract
wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.22.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz
sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.22.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz

# Add to PATH in ~/.bashrc or ~/.profile
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
```

## Verify Installation

```bash
go version
```

**Output:**
```
go version go1.22.0 linux/amd64
```

## Checking Go Version from Inside a Program

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "runtime"
)

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Go version:", runtime.Version())
    fmt.Println("OS:", runtime.GOOS)
    fmt.Println("Architecture:", runtime.GOARCH)
}
```

## Go CLI Commands

### `go run` — Run without building
```bash
go run main.go
```
Compiles and immediately runs a Go file. Great for development.

### `go build` — Compile to binary
```bash
go build -o myapp main.go
```
Produces an executable file ready for distribution.

### `go fmt` — Auto-format code
```bash
go fmt ./...
```
Formats all Go files according to Go standards (indentation, spacing, etc).

### `go vet` — Check for potential bugs
```bash
go vet ./...
```
Analyzes code and reports suspicious constructs.

### `go test` — Run unit tests
```bash
go test ./...
go test -v ./...     # verbose output
go test -cover ./..  # show coverage
```

### `go get` — Add a dependency
```bash
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin
```

### CLI Command Summary

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `go run` | Compile and run immediately |
| `go build` | Compile to executable binary |
| `go fmt` | Format code to Go standards |
| `go vet` | Analyze code for potential bugs |
| `go test` | Run test suite |
| `go get` | Download and install dependency |
| `go mod tidy` | Remove unused dependencies |
